references.text: Describes how a small action or thing can have a great impact, similar to the leaven in the parable.
Illustrates how God's judgment or influence can spread and affect many, parallel to how leaven affects the whole dough.
Another of Jesus' parables that uses leaven to illustrate the kingdom of God shows how small beginnings can lead to great results.
Warns about how a little leaven permeates the whole dough, used here in a negative context regarding sin, but the concept of influence is relevant.
Uses leaven as an image of how a small part can affect the whole, in connection with false teaching, yet again showing the penetrating nature of leaven.
